metadata.intro: Welcome to the Mathematical Methods in Physics gateway. This roadmap connects the foundational tools of calculus and linear algebra to the advanced geometry and group theory that form the language of modern physics.

pillars.title: 1. Calculus, Vector Analysis & Differential Equations
pillars.narrative: The foundational tools for describing continuous change, gradients, and boundary value problems in physical space.

pillars.title: 2. Linear Algebra & Matrix Theory
pillars.narrative: The mathematics of state spaces, linear operators, and unitary transformations required for quantum mechanics and flavor physics.

pillars.title: 3. Complex Analysis & Integral Transforms
pillars.narrative: The power of analytic continuation, contour integration, and integral transforms for solving physical systems and scattering amplitudes.

pillars.title: 4. Group Theory & Symmetries
pillars.narrative: The algebraic study of invariance, providing the structural foundation for the Standard Model and conservation laws.

pillars.title: 5. Differential Geometry & Topology
pillars.narrative: The advanced mathematics of curved manifolds, forms, and invariants essential for General Relativity and modern condensed matter.
